label: Life Insurance
heroSub: Answer a few questions (about 3 minutes) and a licensed Horry County agent will come back with real quotes from multiple carriers. No cost, no obligation, no medical exam to get a quote.
audience: adults 25-80 protecting family income, a mortgage, or final expenses

services.name: Term Life Insurance
services.angle: affordable fixed-period coverage to replace income and protect a mortgage while kids are young

faqs.q: How much term life insurance do I need?
faqs.a: A common starting point is 10–12 times your annual income, adjusted for your mortgage, debts, children's education goals, and savings. A licensed agent can run the numbers with you.

faqs.q: What happens when my term ends?
faqs.a: Coverage stops unless the policy is renewable or convertible. Many term policies let you convert to permanent coverage without a new medical exam before a set age.

services.name: Whole Life Insurance
services.angle: permanent coverage with level premiums and cash value for people who want lifelong protection

faqs.q: Is whole life worth the higher premium?
faqs.a: It depends on your goals. Whole life costs more than term but lasts your entire life and builds cash value. It tends to fit people with permanent needs such as estate planning or a lifelong dependent.

services.name: Final Expense Insurance
services.angle: small whole life policies (often $5k–$35k) for seniors to cover funeral costs and final bills, frequently with simplified underwriting

faqs.q: Can I get final expense insurance without a medical exam?
faqs.a: Many final expense policies use simplified issue underwriting, meaning a health questionnaire instead of an exam. Some guaranteed-issue options exist, usually with a waiting period.
Most carriers offer final expense coverage to applicants roughly 50 to 85, though limits vary by carrier and state.

services.name: Mortgage Protection Insurance
services.angle: life coverage sized to a home loan so the family keeps the house if a borrower dies

faqs.q: Is mortgage protection the same as PMI?
faqs.a: No. PMI protects the lender if you stop paying. Mortgage protection life insurance pays your family, who can use it to pay off or keep paying the mortgage.

form._comment: This is a pre-application: everything an agent needs to run quotes, so the first call is an offer. Never add SSN, bank or card fields here; those are collected only inside the carrier e-application.
form.intro: About 3 minutes. Your answers let a licensed agent bring real prices to the first call.

fields.name: coverage_reason
fields.label: Main reason
options: Replace or add to a policy I have

fields.name: term_length
fields.label: How long do you need it?
options: Until my mortgage is paid off

steps.title: About you
steps.help: Insurance prices are based on age, sex, build and tobacco use.

fields.name: tobacco
fields.label: Tobacco or nicotine use
options: Vape or e-cigarette in the last 12 months
Cigars, pipe or chew in the last 12 months
Nicotine patch or gum in the last 12 months

steps.title: Your health
steps.help: Honest answers mean an accurate quote. This is not an application and doesn't commit you to anything.

fields.name: conditions
fields.label: Have you ever been diagnosed with or treated for any of these?
options: Heart attack, stents or heart surgery
In a nursing home, hospice, or need help with daily activities

fields.name: condition_details
fields.label: For anything you checked: when was it diagnosed, and how is it treated now?

fields.name: medications
fields.label: Medications you take regularly (optional)
fields.placeholder: Names are enough, e.g. lisinopril, atorvastatin
fields.help: Helps us pick the carrier most likely to approve you at the best price.

fields.name: hospital_2yr
fields.label: Any overnight hospital stay in the last 2 years?

fields.name: dui_5yr
fields.label: Any DUI in the last 5 years?

steps.title: Where should we send your quotes?

scoring._comment: Points add up to a 0-100 score. Tier: A >= 70, B >= 45, else C. _age is computed from dob.

compliance.notAProvider: {{brand}} is not an insurance company and does not issue policies. We connect you with licensed insurance agents. Quotes, rates and eligibility are determined by carriers and depend on underwriting.
contentRules: Never state specific premiums, rates or guarantees of approval.
Never claim to be an insurer, carrier, or licensed agent.
Never use words like 'free money', 'government program', or imply affiliation with Medicare or any agency.
Health and underwriting statements must be general and hedged ('may', 'often', 'depends on the carrier').

underwriting._comment: Rough triage shown in the admin quote sheet. Carriers differ; always confirm with the carrier underwriting guide.
guaranteedIssue: In a nursing home, hospice, or need help with daily activities
graded: Heart attack, stents or heart surgery

callChecklist: Confirm name, date of birth, height/weight and tobacco answer from the form
Walk through each health condition: diagnosis date, treatment, last doctor visit
Confirm full medication list (dose not needed for most carriers)
Beneficiary: full name, relationship, date of birth (and percentage if more than one)
Existing life insurance: carrier, amount, and whether this replaces it (SC replacement form if so)
Driver license number (some carrier e-apps ask)
Social Security number: enter ONLY inside the carrier e-application, never in notes or texts
Bank routing/account for premium draft and preferred draft date: carrier e-app only
Explain next steps: phone interview or e-signature, and when coverage starts
